citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
A cynomolgus macaque underwent a study-approved surgical procedure under protocol 20XXXXXXX62 on May 8, 2026.
The approved protocol includes both a long-acting buprenorphine and 3 days of treatment with meloxicam for post-
procedural pain control. The animal received buprenorphine on the day of the procedure; however, meloxicam was not
administered. Although long-acting buprenorphine was administered and there were no signs of pain observed in the
animal, failure to administer all post-procedural analgesics in accordance with the protocol constitutes a change that did
not undergo IACUC review and approval.
This item was identified by the facility prior to inspection and corrective measures were implemented, including retraining
study personnel and creating detailed study plans for all surgical procedures.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representatives.
